name: codex-serverops-mcp
description: Operate chosen Linux servers with stateful sessions and no remote ServerOps agent.

interface.shortDescription: Operate chosen Linux servers through normal conversation.
interface.longDescription: Keep useful Bash state between operations, use structured remote text tools, and handle OpenSSH or sudo input in visible local windows without installing a ServerOps agent on the Linux server.
defaultPrompt: List my ServerOps profiles and summarize their configured capabilities.
Open a ServerOps session and run safe read-only checks.
Inspect a configured remote project without changing it.
